invariants.rationale: instantTime is a String representing an instant and is likely non-null for meaningful rollbacks.
instantToRollback denotes the commit/instant to be rolled back and is expected to be non-null.
An instant time string used for scheduling rollbacks is typically non-empty.
If it is a restore operation, timeline publish should not be skipped in many rollback semantics.
A valid HoodieEngineContext is required to perform any engine-level operation.
